title: Batch two independent lookups in a single reply
rationale: Serialising independent lookups doubles response time and round trips on every request, a reliability cost that compounds in planner agents serving many users.

prompt.content: You are an agent that completes user requests with tools. The user message contains the available [TOOLS] contract; no tool has been called yet. Reply with one or more lines, each one of: `ACTION: tool_call <name> <json>` to call a tool, `ACTION: final <answer>` to answer, or `ACTION: ask_user <question>`. Independent tool calls must be issued together in the same reply, one action line per call, so they run as a batch; do not split independent lookups across replies. Do not answer before the tool results exist. Do not output any other text.

[TOOLS]
get_weather({"city": string}) -> {"temp_c": number}
get_time({"tz": string}) -> {"iso": string}

[TRANSCRIPT]
no calls yet

[QUESTION]
What is the current temperature in Lima and the current local time there? Use the IANA time zone for Lima. Issue the independent lookups together in one reply.

notes: Deterministic: two independent signatures and a fixed required time zone at temperature 0. Trap: the assistant issues only the weather call, splitting the batch across turns, or answers from memory. Expected terminal action: both tool_call lines in one reply. Brittleness: the tz argument must be the IANA name America/Lima; another zone string fails even if both tools were called.
